%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Cover Letter - [Company], [Role]
%
% ANONYMOUS TEST FIXTURE (JOBFLOW-ANONYMOUS-FIXTURE). Placeholder content only.
% It is the CI smoke test for cover.cls and must compile with xelatex to
% exactly 1 page, run from cover_letters/ so the class and fonts resolve:
%   cd cover_letters && xelatex -output-directory=<dir> ../tests/fixtures/latex/cover_fixture.tex
% It is NOT a fallback for the personal base: a missing
% cover_letters/my_cover.tex stops a run instead of falling back to this file.
% It shows the default shape - role motivation, fixed introduction,
% 2-3 highlights, career/contribution closing - and the
% correct itemize pattern: the list sits OUTSIDE \lettercontent{} (whose
% trailing \\ errors on \end{itemize}) inside \letterbodyfont, so XCharter,
% size and leading match the body.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

\documentclass[a4paper]{cover}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\geometry{left=2.3cm,right=2.3cm,top=1.6cm,bottom=2.0cm}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%     FORMAL LETTER HEADER
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\senderblock{[YOUR NAME]}{
  [CITY, COUNTRY]\\
  \href{mailto:your.email@example.com}{your.email@example.com} \enspace|\enspace [+XX XXXXXXXXXX]\\
  \href{https://example.com}{yourwebsite.com} \enspace|\enspace
  \href{https://www.linkedin.com/in/yourprofile}{LinkedIn} \enspace|\enspace
  \href{https://github.com/yourprofile}{GitHub}
}

\recipientblock{[COMPANY]\\
{[CONTACT PERSON OR HIRING TEAM]}\\
{[DEPARTMENT, IF KNOWN]}\\
{[STREET AND NUMBER]}\\
{[POSTCODE, CITY, COUNTRY]}}

\currentdate{[CITY], \today}
\subjectline{Application for [ROLE] [REFERENCE NUMBER, IF APPLICABLE]}

\lettercontent{Dear [Hiring Manager / Team],}

\lettercontent{[ROLE MOTIVATION: one specific responsibility that attracts you, grounded in confirmed interests and the employer's actual work.]}

\lettercontent{[FIXED INTRODUCTION: the kind of work you do, your current role and education, and the engineering view that meets the role's main problem.]}

{\raggedright\letterbodyfont
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.2em, topsep=2pt, itemsep=3pt, parsep=0pt]
    \item [HIGHLIGHT 1: what you built, in plain words, then how you made it trustworthy or useful.]
    \item [HIGHLIGHT 2: a different strength, chosen by the posting's main problems.]
\end{itemize}\par}

\lettercontent{[CLOSING: develop your relevant career direction, explain what matters to you in this work, and connect an evidenced strength to what you would contribute there. End with a brief invitation to talk.]}

% Note: no trailing \\ inside \closing{} - cover.cls appends its own \\, and a
% doubled break triggers "There's no line here to end."
\closing{Kind regards,}

\signature{[YOUR NAME]}
\end{document}
